// The same call with a later beta value.
export async function readOne(p) {
  const key = p.env.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN;
  const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/v1/messages', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'x-api-key': key,
      'anthropic-beta': 'oauth-2026-09-30',
    },
    body: '{}',
  });
  return res.status;
}
